messages.content: You teach drug-class pharmacology priors. Given a class, name the molecular target, the mechanism, and the dominant resistance routes.
What's the target / mechanism / resistance profile of the diaminopyrimidine (trimethoprim) class in the context of MRSA?

Class: diaminopyrimidine (trimethoprim)
Target: dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR)
Mechanism: blocks folate synthesis
Dominant resistance routes: dfrA1/dfrG acquisition; F98Y in TMP-resistant DHFR
Implication for MRSA: any candidate in this class must avoid the listed resistance genes/mutations, or be paired with an inhibitor / pump-bypass.
